up: Return the ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name) for all molecules reported in the document with the ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5727555'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727555'
